     1→// Entire CLI plugin for OpenCode
     2→// Auto-generated by `entire enable --agent opencode`
     3→// Do not edit manually — changes will be overwritten on next install.
     4→// Requires Bun runtime (used by OpenCode's plugin system for loading ESM plugins).
     5→import type { Plugin } from "@opencode-ai/plugin"
     6→import { tmpdir } from "node:os"
     7→
     8→export const EntirePlugin: Plugin = async ({ client, directory, $ }) => {
     9→  const ENTIRE_CMD = "__ENTIRE_CMD__"
    10→  // Store transcripts in a temp directory — these are ephemeral handoff files
    11→  // between the plugin and the Go hook handler. Once checkpointed, the data
    12→  // lives on git refs and the file is disposable.
    13→  const sanitized = directory.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, "-")
    14→  const transcriptDir = `${tmpdir()}/entire-opencode/${sanitized}`
    15→  const seenUserMessages = new Set<string>()
    16→
    17→  // In-memory stores — used to write transcripts without relying on the SDK API,
    18→  // which may be unavailable during shutdown.
    19→  // messageStore: keyed by message ID, stores message metadata (role, time, tokens, etc.)
    20→  const messageStore = new Map<string, any>()
    21→  // partStore: keyed by message ID, stores accumulated parts from message.part.updated events
    22→  const partStore = new Map<string, any[]>()
    23→  let currentSessionID: string | null = null
    24→
    25→  // Ensure transcript directory exists
    26→  await $`mkdir -p ${transcriptDir}`.quiet().nothrow()
    27→
    28→  /**
    29→   * Pipe JSON payload to an entire hooks command.
    30→   * Errors are logged but never thrown — plugin failures must not crash OpenCode.
    31→   */
    32→  async function callHook(hookName: string, payload: Record<string, unknown>) {
    33→    try {
    34→      const json = JSON.stringify(payload)
    35→      await $`echo ${json} | ${ENTIRE_CMD} hooks opencode ${hookName}`.quiet().nothrow()
    36→    } catch {
    37→      // Silently ignore — plugin failures must not crash OpenCode
    38→    }
    39→  }
    40→
    41→  /** Extract text content from a list of parts. */
    42→  function textFromParts(parts: any[]): string {
    43→    return parts
    44→      .filter((p: any) => p.type === "text")
    45→      .map((p: any) => p.text ?? "")
    46→      .join("\n")
    47→  }
    48→
    49→  /** Format a message for the transcript using its accumulated parts. */
    50→  function formatMessageFromStore(msg: any) {
    51→    const parts = partStore.get(msg.id) ?? []
    52→    return {
    53→      id: msg.id,
    54→      role: msg.role,
    55→      content: textFromParts(parts),
    56→      time: msg.time,
    57→      ...(msg.role === "assistant" ? {
    58→        tokens: msg.tokens,
    59→        cost: msg.cost,
    60→        parts: parts.map((p: any) => ({
    61→          type: p.type,
    62→          ...(p.type === "text" ? { text: p.text } : {}),
    63→          ...(p.type === "tool" ? { tool: p.tool, callID: p.callID, state: p.state } : {}),
    64→        })),
    65→      } : {}),
    66→    }
    67→  }
    68→
    69→  /** Format a message from an API response (which includes parts inline). */
    70→  function formatMessageFromAPI(info: any, parts: any[]) {
    71→    return {
    72→      id: info.id,
    73→      role: info.role,
    74→      content: textFromParts(parts),
    75→      time: info.time,
    76→      ...(info.role === "assistant" ? {
    77→        tokens: info.tokens,
    78→        cost: info.cost,
    79→        parts: parts.map((p: any) => ({
    80→          type: p.type,
    81→          ...(p.type === "text" ? { text: p.text } : {}),
    82→          ...(p.type === "tool" ? { tool: p.tool, callID: p.callID, state: p.state } : {}),
    83→        })),
    84→      } : {}),
    85→    }
    86→  }
    87→
    88→  /**
    89→   * Write transcript from in-memory stores (messageStore + partStore).
    90→   * This does NOT call the SDK API, so it works even during shutdown.
    91→   */
    92→  async function writeTranscriptFromMemory(sessionID: string): Promise<string> {
    93→    const transcriptPath = `${transcriptDir}/${sessionID}.json`
    94→    try {
    95→      const messages = Array.from(messageStore.values())
    96→        .sort((a, b) => (a.time?.created ?? 0) - (b.time?.created ?? 0))
    97→
    98→      const transcript = {
    99→        session_id: sessionID,
   100→        messages: messages.map(formatMessageFromStore),
   101→      }
   102→      await Bun.write(transcriptPath, JSON.stringify(transcript))
   103→    } catch {
   104→      // Silently ignore write failures
   105→    }
   106→    return transcriptPath
   107→  }
   108→
   109→  /**
   110→   * Try to fetch messages via the SDK API (returns messages with parts inline)
   111→   * and write transcript. Falls back to in-memory stores if the API is unavailable.
   112→   */
   113→  async function writeTranscriptWithFallback(sessionID: string): Promise<string> {
   114→    const transcriptPath = `${transcriptDir}/${sessionID}.json`
   115→    try {
   116→      const response = await client.session.message.list({ path: { id: sessionID } })
   117→      // API returns Array<{ info: Message, parts: Array<Part> }>
   118→      const items = response.data ?? []
   119→
   120→      const transcript = {
   121→        session_id: sessionID,
   122→        messages: items.map((item: any) => formatMessageFromAPI(item.info, item.parts ?? [])),
   123→      }
   124→      await Bun.write(transcriptPath, JSON.stringify(transcript))
   125→      return transcriptPath
   126→    } catch {
   127→      // API unavailable (likely shutting down) — fall back to in-memory stores
   128→      return writeTranscriptFromMemory(sessionID)
   129→    }
   130→  }
   131→
   132→  return {
   133→    event: async ({ event }) => {
   134→      switch (event.type) {
   135→        case "session.created": {
   136→          const session = (event as any).properties?.info
   137→          if (!session?.id) break
   138→          currentSessionID = session.id
   139→          await callHook("session-start", {
   140→            session_id: session.id,
   141→            transcript_path: `${transcriptDir}/${session.id}.json`,
   142→          })
   143→          break
   144→        }
   145→
   146→        case "message.updated": {
   147→          const msg = (event as any).properties?.info
   148→          if (!msg) break
   149→          // Store message metadata (role, time, tokens, etc.)
   150→          // Content is NOT on the message — it arrives via message.part.updated events.
   151→          messageStore.set(msg.id, msg)
   152→          break
   153→        }
   154→
   155→        case "message.part.updated": {
   156→          const part = (event as any).properties?.part
   157→          if (!part?.messageID) break
   158→
   159→          // Accumulate parts per message
   160→          const existing = partStore.get(part.messageID) ?? []
   161→          // Replace existing part with same id, or append new one
   162→          const idx = existing.findIndex((p: any) => p.id === part.id)
   163→          if (idx >= 0) {
   164→            existing[idx] = part
   165→          } else {
   166→            existing.push(part)
   167→          }
   168→          partStore.set(part.messageID, existing)
   169→
   170→          // Fire turn-start on the first text part of a new user message
   171→          const msg = messageStore.get(part.messageID)
   172→          if (msg?.role === "user" && part.type === "text" && !seenUserMessages.has(msg.id)) {
   173→            seenUserMessages.add(msg.id)
   174→            const sessionID = msg.sessionID ?? currentSessionID
   175→            if (sessionID) {
   176→              await callHook("turn-start", {
   177→                session_id: sessionID,
   178→                transcript_path: `${transcriptDir}/${sessionID}.json`,
   179→                prompt: part.text ?? "",
   180→              })
   181→            }
   182→          }
   183→          break
   184→        }
   185→
   186→        case "session.idle": {
   187→          const sessionID = (event as any).properties?.sessionID
   188→          if (!sessionID) break
   189→          const transcriptPath = await writeTranscriptWithFallback(sessionID)
   190→          await callHook("turn-end", {
   191→            session_id: sessionID,
   192→            transcript_path: transcriptPath,
   193→          })
   194→          break
   195→        }
   196→
   197→        case "session.compacted": {
   198→          const sessionID = (event as any).properties?.sessionID
   199→          if (!sessionID) break
   200→          await callHook("compaction", {
   201→            session_id: sessionID,
   202→            transcript_path: `${transcriptDir}/${sessionID}.json`,
   203→          })
   204→          break
   205→        }
   206→
   207→        case "session.deleted": {
   208→          const session = (event as any).properties?.info
   209→          if (!session?.id) break
   210→          // Write final transcript before signaling session end
   211→          if (messageStore.size > 0) {
   212→            await writeTranscriptFromMemory(session.id)
   213→          }
   214→          seenUserMessages.clear()
   215→          messageStore.clear()
   216→          partStore.clear()
   217→          currentSessionID = null
   218→          await callHook("session-end", {
   219→            session_id: session.id,
   220→            transcript_path: `${transcriptDir}/${session.id}.json`,
   221→          })
   222→          break
   223→        }
   224→      }
   225→    },
   226→  }
   227→}
   228→

     1→package opencode
     2→
     3→import (
     4→	"encoding/json"
     5→	"fmt"
     6→	"os"
     7→	"slices"
     8→
     9→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/agent"
    10→)
    11→
    12→// Compile-time interface assertions
    13→var (
    14→	_ agent.TranscriptAnalyzer = (*OpenCodeAgent)(nil)
    15→	_ agent.TokenCalculator    = (*OpenCodeAgent)(nil)
    16→)
    17→
    18→// ParseTranscript parses raw JSON content into a transcript structure.
    19→func ParseTranscript(data []byte) (*Transcript, error) {
    20→	var t Transcript
    21→	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &t); err != nil {
    22→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse opencode transcript: %w", err)
    23→	}
    24→	return &t, nil
    25→}
    26→
    27→// parseTranscriptFile reads and parses a transcript JSON file.
    28→func parseTranscriptFile(path string) (*Transcript, error) {
    29→	data, err := os.ReadFile(path) //nolint:gosec // Path from agent hook
    30→	if err != nil {
    31→		return nil, err //nolint:wrapcheck // Callers check os.IsNotExist on this error
    32→	}
    33→	var t Transcript
    34→	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &t); err != nil {
    35→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse opencode transcript: %w", err)
    36→	}
    37→	return &t, nil
    38→}
    39→
    40→// GetTranscriptPosition returns the number of messages in the transcript.
    41→func (a *OpenCodeAgent) GetTranscriptPosition(path string) (int, error) {
    42→	t, err := parseTranscriptFile(path)
    43→	if err != nil {
    44→		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
    45→			return 0, nil
    46→		}
    47→		return 0, err
    48→	}
    49→	return len(t.Messages), nil
    50→}
    51→
    52→// ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset extracts files modified by tool calls from the given message offset.
    53→func (a *OpenCodeAgent) ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset(path string, startOffset int) ([]string, int, error) {
    54→	t, err := parseTranscriptFile(path)
    55→	if err != nil {
    56→		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
    57→			return nil, 0, nil
    58→		}
    59→		return nil, 0, err
    60→	}
    61→
    62→	seen := make(map[string]bool)
    63→	var files []string
    64→
    65→	for i := startOffset; i < len(t.Messages); i++ {
    66→		msg := t.Messages[i]
    67→		if msg.Role != roleAssistant {
    68→			continue
    69→		}
    70→		for _, part := range msg.Parts {
    71→			if part.Type != "tool" || part.State == nil {
    72→				continue
    73→			}
    74→			if !slices.Contains(FileModificationTools, part.Tool) {
    75→				continue
    76→			}
    77→			filePath := extractFilePathFromInput(part.State.Input)
    78→			if filePath != "" && !seen[filePath] {
    79→				seen[filePath] = true
    80→				files = append(files, filePath)
    81→			}
    82→		}
    83→	}
    84→
    85→	return files, len(t.Messages), nil
    86→}
    87→
    88→// ExtractModifiedFiles extracts modified file paths from raw transcript bytes.
    89→// This is the bytes-based equivalent of ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset, used by ReadSession.
    90→func ExtractModifiedFiles(data []byte) ([]string, error) {
    91→	t, err := ParseTranscript(data)
    92→	if err != nil {
    93→		return nil, err
    94→	}
    95→
    96→	seen := make(map[string]bool)
    97→	var files []string
    98→
    99→	for _, msg := range t.Messages {
   100→		if msg.Role != roleAssistant {
   101→			continue
   102→		}
   103→		for _, part := range msg.Parts {
   104→			if part.Type != "tool" || part.State == nil {
   105→				continue
   106→			}
   107→			if !slices.Contains(FileModificationTools, part.Tool) {
   108→				continue
   109→			}
   110→			filePath := extractFilePathFromInput(part.State.Input)
   111→			if filePath != "" && !seen[filePath] {
   112→				seen[filePath] = true
   113→				files = append(files, filePath)
   114→			}
   115→		}
   116→	}
   117→
   118→	return files, nil
   119→}
   120→
   121→// extractFilePathFromInput extracts the file path from a tool's input map.
   122→func extractFilePathFromInput(input map[string]interface{}) string {
   123→	for _, key := range []string{"file_path", "path", "file", "filename"} {
   124→		if v, ok := input[key]; ok {
   125→			if s, ok := v.(string); ok && s != "" {
   126→				return s
   127→			}
   128→		}
   129→	}
   130→	return ""
   131→}
   132→
   133→// ExtractPrompts extracts user prompt strings from the transcript starting at the given offset.
   134→func (a *OpenCodeAgent) ExtractPrompts(sessionRef string, fromOffset int) ([]string, error) {
   135→	t, err := parseTranscriptFile(sessionRef)
   136→	if err != nil {
   137→		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   138→			return nil, nil
   139→		}
   140→		return nil, err
   141→	}
   142→
   143→	var prompts []string
   144→	for i := fromOffset; i < len(t.Messages); i++ {
   145→		msg := t.Messages[i]
   146→		if msg.Role == roleUser && msg.Content != "" {
   147→			prompts = append(prompts, msg.Content)
   148→		}
   149→	}
   150→
   151→	return prompts, nil
   152→}
   153→
   154→// ExtractSummary extracts the last assistant message content as a summary.
   155→func (a *OpenCodeAgent) ExtractSummary(sessionRef string) (string, error) {
   156→	t, err := parseTranscriptFile(sessionRef)
   157→	if err != nil {
   158→		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   159→			return "", nil
   160→		}
   161→		return "", err
   162→	}
   163→
   164→	for i := len(t.Messages) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
   165→		msg := t.Messages[i]
   166→		if msg.Role == roleAssistant && msg.Content != "" {
   167→			return msg.Content, nil
   168→		}
   169→	}
   170→
   171→	return "", nil
   172→}
   173→
   174→// SliceFromMessage returns a JSON transcript containing only messages from startMessageIndex onward.
   175→// This is used by explain to scope a full transcript to a specific checkpoint's portion.
   176→func SliceFromMessage(data []byte, startMessageIndex int) []byte {
   177→	if len(data) == 0 || startMessageIndex <= 0 {
   178→		return data
   179→	}
   180→
   181→	t, err := ParseTranscript(data)
   182→	if err != nil {
   183→		return nil
   184→	}
   185→
   186→	if startMessageIndex >= len(t.Messages) {
   187→		return nil
   188→	}
   189→
   190→	scoped := &Transcript{
   191→		SessionID: t.SessionID,
   192→		Messages:  t.Messages[startMessageIndex:],
   193→	}
   194→
   195→	out, err := json.Marshal(scoped)
   196→	if err != nil {
   197→		return nil
   198→	}
   199→	return out
   200→}
   201→
   202→// ExtractAllUserPrompts extracts all user prompts from raw transcript bytes.
   203→// This is a package-level function used by the condensation path.
   204→func ExtractAllUserPrompts(data []byte) ([]string, error) {
   205→	t, err := ParseTranscript(data)
   206→	if err != nil {
   207→		return nil, err
   208→	}
   209→
   210→	var prompts []string
   211→	for _, msg := range t.Messages {
   212→		if msg.Role == roleUser && msg.Content != "" {
   213→			prompts = append(prompts, msg.Content)
   214→		}
   215→	}
   216→	return prompts, nil
   217→}
   218→
   219→// CalculateTokenUsageFromBytes computes token usage from raw transcript bytes starting at the given message offset.
   220→// This is a package-level function used by the condensation path (which has bytes, not a file path).
   221→func CalculateTokenUsageFromBytes(data []byte, startMessageIndex int) *agent.TokenUsage {
   222→	t, err := ParseTranscript(data)
   223→	if err != nil || t == nil {
   224→		return &agent.TokenUsage{}
   225→	}
   226→
   227→	usage := &agent.TokenUsage{}
   228→	for i := startMessageIndex; i < len(t.Messages); i++ {
   229→		msg := t.Messages[i]
   230→		if msg.Role != roleAssistant || msg.Tokens == nil {
   231→			continue
   232→		}
   233→		usage.InputTokens += msg.Tokens.Input
   234→		usage.OutputTokens += msg.Tokens.Output
   235→		usage.CacheReadTokens += msg.Tokens.Cache.Read
   236→		usage.CacheCreationTokens += msg.Tokens.Cache.Write
   237→		usage.APICallCount++
   238→	}
   239→
   240→	return usage
   241→}
   242→
   243→// CalculateTokenUsage computes token usage from assistant messages starting at the given offset.
   244→func (a *OpenCodeAgent) CalculateTokenUsage(sessionRef string, fromOffset int) (*agent.TokenUsage, error) {
   245→	t, err := parseTranscriptFile(sessionRef)
   246→	if err != nil {
   247→		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   248→			return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil // nil usage for nonexistent file is expected
   249→		}
   250→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript for token usage: %w", err)
   251→	}
   252→
   253→	usage := &agent.TokenUsage{}
   254→	for i := fromOffset; i < len(t.Messages); i++ {
   255→		msg := t.Messages[i]
   256→		if msg.Role != roleAssistant || msg.Tokens == nil {
   257→			continue
   258→		}
   259→		usage.InputTokens += msg.Tokens.Input
   260→		usage.OutputTokens += msg.Tokens.Output
   261→		usage.CacheReadTokens += msg.Tokens.Cache.Read
   262→		usage.CacheCreationTokens += msg.Tokens.Cache.Write
   263→		usage.APICallCount++
   264→	}
   265→
   266→	return usage, nil
   267→}

     1→package opencode
     2→
     3→// sessionInfoRaw matches the JSON payload piped from the OpenCode plugin for session events.
     4→type sessionInfoRaw struct {
     5→	SessionID      string `json:"session_id"`
     6→	TranscriptPath string `json:"transcript_path"`
     7→}
     8→
     9→// turnStartRaw matches the JSON payload for turn-start (user prompt submission).
    10→type turnStartRaw struct {
    11→	SessionID      string `json:"session_id"`
    12→	TranscriptPath string `json:"transcript_path"`
    13→	Prompt         string `json:"prompt"`
    14→}
    15→
    16→// --- Transcript types (JSON format, similar to Gemini CLI) ---
    17→
    18→// Message role constants.
    19→const (
    20→	roleAssistant = "assistant"
    21→	roleUser      = "user"
    22→)
    23→
    24→// Transcript represents the full transcript JSON written by the plugin.
    25→type Transcript struct {
    26→	SessionID string    `json:"session_id"`
    27→	Messages  []Message `json:"messages"`
    28→}
    29→
    30→// Message represents a single message in the transcript.
    31→type Message struct {
    32→	ID      string  `json:"id"`
    33→	Role    string  `json:"role"` // "user" or "assistant"
    34→	Content string  `json:"content"`
    35→	Time    Time    `json:"time"`
    36→	Tokens  *Tokens `json:"tokens,omitempty"`
    37→	Cost    float64 `json:"cost,omitempty"`
    38→	Parts   []Part  `json:"parts,omitempty"`
    39→}
    40→
    41→// Time holds message timestamps.
    42→type Time struct {
    43→	Created   int64 `json:"created"`
    44→	Completed int64 `json:"completed,omitempty"`
    45→}
    46→
    47→// Tokens holds token usage from assistant messages.
    48→type Tokens struct {
    49→	Input     int   `json:"input"`
    50→	Output    int   `json:"output"`
    51→	Reasoning int   `json:"reasoning"`

    63→func (a *OpenCodeAgent) ChunkTranscript(content []byte, maxSize int) ([][]byte, error) {
    64→	// OpenCode uses JSON format (like Gemini). Parse and split by messages.
    65→	if len(content) <= maxSize {
    66→		return [][]byte{content}, nil
    67→	}
    68→
    69→	var transcript Transcript
    70→	if err := json.Unmarshal(content, &transcript); err != nil {
    71→		// Fallback to JSONL chunking if not valid JSON
    72→		chunks, chunkErr := agent.ChunkJSONL(content, maxSize)
    73→		if chunkErr != nil {
    74→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to chunk transcript as JSONL: %w", chunkErr)
    75→		}
    76→		return chunks, nil
    77→	}
    78→
    79→	if len(transcript.Messages) == 0 {
    80→		return [][]byte{content}, nil
    81→	}
    82→
    83→	// Pre-marshal each message to avoid O(n²) re-serialization.
    84→	// Track running size and split at chunk boundaries (same approach as Gemini).
    85→	var chunks [][]byte
    86→	var currentMessages []Message
    87→	baseSize := len(fmt.Sprintf(`{"session_id":%q,"messages":[]}`, transcript.SessionID))
    88→	currentSize := baseSize
    89→
    90→	for _, msg := range transcript.Messages {
    91→		msgBytes, err := json.Marshal(msg)
    92→		if err != nil {
    93→			continue // Skip messages that fail to marshal
    94→		}
    95→		msgSize := len(msgBytes) + 1 // +1 for comma separator
    96→
    97→		if currentSize+msgSize > maxSize && len(currentMessages) > 0 {
    98→			// Save current chunk
    99→			chunkData, marshalErr := json.Marshal(Transcript{
   100→				SessionID: transcript.SessionID,
   101→				Messages:  currentMessages,
   102→			})
   103→			if marshalErr != nil {
   104→				return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal transcript chunk: %w", marshalErr)
   105→			}
   106→			chunks = append(chunks, chunkData)
   107→
   108→			// Start new chunk
   109→			currentMessages = nil
   110→			currentSize = baseSize
   111→		}
   112→
   113→		currentMessages = append(currentMessages, msg)
   114→		currentSize += msgSize
   115→	}
   116→
   117→	// Save remaining messages
   118→	if len(currentMessages) > 0 {
   119→		chunkData, err := json.Marshal(Transcript{
   120→			SessionID: transcript.SessionID,
   121→			Messages:  currentMessages,
   122→		})
   123→		if err != nil {
   124→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal final transcript chunk: %w", err)
   125→		}
   126→		chunks = append(chunks, chunkData)
   127→	}
   128→
   129→	return chunks, nil
   130→}
   131→
   132→func (a *OpenCodeAgent) ReassembleTranscript(chunks [][]byte) ([]byte, error) {
   133→	if len(chunks) == 0 {
   134→		return nil, nil
   135→	}
   136→	if len(chunks) == 1 {
   137→		return chunks[0], nil
   138→	}
   139→
   140→	var combined Transcript
   141→	for i, chunk := range chunks {
   142→		var t Transcript
   143→		if err := json.Unmarshal(chunk, &t); err != nil {
   144→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript chunk %d: %w", i, err)
   145→		}
   146→		if i == 0 {
   147→			combined.SessionID = t.SessionID
   148→		}
   149→		combined.Messages = append(combined.Messages, t.Messages...)
   150→	}

   152→	data, err := json.Marshal(combined)
   153→	if err != nil {
   154→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal reassembled transcript: %w", err)
   155→	}
   156→	return data, nil
   157→}

   143→		case geminicli.MessageTypeUser:
   144→			if msg.Content != "" {
   145→				entries = append(entries, Entry{
   146→					Type:    EntryTypeUser,
   147→					Content: msg.Content,
   148→				})
   149→			}
   150→		case geminicli.MessageTypeGemini:
   151→			// Add assistant content
   152→			if msg.Content != "" {
   153→				entries = append(entries, Entry{
   154→					Type:    EntryTypeAssistant,
   155→					Content: msg.Content,
   156→				})
   157→			}
   158→			// Add tool calls
   159→			for _, tc := range msg.ToolCalls {
   160→				entries = append(entries, Entry{
   161→					Type:       EntryTypeTool,
   162→					ToolName:   tc.Name,
   163→					ToolDetail: extractGenericToolDetail(tc.Args),
   164→				})
   165→			}
   166→		}
   167→	}
   168→
   169→	return entries, nil
   170→}
   171→
   172→// buildCondensedTranscriptFromOpenCode parses OpenCode JSON transcript and extracts a condensed view.
   173→func buildCondensedTranscriptFromOpenCode(content []byte) ([]Entry, error) {
   174→	ocTranscript, err := opencode.ParseTranscript(content)
   175→	if err != nil {
   176→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse OpenCode transcript: %w", err)
   177→	}
   178→
   179→	var entries []Entry
   180→	for _, msg := range ocTranscript.Messages {
   181→		switch msg.Role {
   182→		case "user":
   183→			if msg.Content != "" {
   184→				entries = append(entries, Entry{
   185→					Type:    EntryTypeUser,
   186→					Content: msg.Content,
   187→				})
   188→			}
   189→		case "assistant":
   190→			if msg.Content != "" {
   191→				entries = append(entries, Entry{
   192→					Type:    EntryTypeAssistant,
   193→					Content: msg.Content,
   194→				})
   195→			}
   196→			for _, part := range msg.Parts {
   197→				if part.Type == "tool" && part.State != nil {
   198→					entries = append(entries, Entry{
   199→						Type:       EntryTypeTool,
   200→						ToolName:   part.Tool,
   201→						ToolDetail: extractGenericToolDetail(part.State.Input),
   202→					})
   203→				}
   204→			}
   205→		}
   206→	}
   207→
   208→	return entries, nil
   209→}
   210→
   211→// extractGenericToolDetail extracts an appropriate detail string from a tool's input/args map.
   212→// Checks common fields in order of preference. Used by both OpenCode and Gemini condensation.
   213→func extractGenericToolDetail(input map[string]interface{}) string {
   214→	for _, key := range []string{"description", "command", "file_path", "path", "pattern"} {
   215→		if v, ok := input[key].(string); ok && v != "" {
   216→			return v
   217→		}
   218→	}
   219→	return ""
   220→}

Once checkpointed, the data\n  // lives on git refs and the file is disposable.\n  const sanitized = directory.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, \"-\")\n  const transcriptDir = `${tmpdir()}/entire-opencode/${sanitized}`\n  const seenUserMessages = new Set<string>()\n\n  // In-memory stores — used to write transcripts without relying on the SDK API,\n  // which may be unavailable during shutdown.\n  // messageStore: keyed by message ID, stores message metadata (role, time, tokens, etc.)\n  const messageStore = new Map<string, any>()\n  // partStore: keyed by message ID, stores accumulated parts from message.part.updated events\n  const partStore = new Map<string, any[]>()\n  let currentSessionID: string | null = null\n\n  // Ensure transcript directory exists\n  await $`mkdir -p ${transcriptDir}`.quiet().nothrow()\n\n  /**\n   * Pipe JSON payload to an entire hooks command.\n   * Errors are logged but never thrown — plugin failures must not crash OpenCode.\n   */\n  async function callHook(hookName: string, payload: Record<string, unknown>) {\n    try {\n      const json = JSON.stringify(payload)\n      await $`echo ${json} | ${ENTIRE_CMD} hooks opencode ${hookName}`.quiet().nothrow()\n    } catch {\n      // Silently ignore — plugin failures must not crash OpenCode\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** Extract text content from a list of parts. */\n  function textFromParts(parts: any[]): string {\n    return parts\n      .filter((p: any) => p.type === \"text\")\n      .map((p: any) => p.text ?? \"\")\n      .join(\"\\n\")\n  }\n\n  /** Format a message object from its accumulated parts. */\n  function formatMessageFromStore(msg: any) {\n    const parts = partStore.get(msg.id) ?? Falls back to in-memory stores if the API is unavailable.\n   */\n  async function writeTranscriptWithFallback(sessionID: string): Promise<string> {\n    const transcriptPath = `${transcriptDir}/${sessionID}.jsonl`\n    try {\n      const response = await client.session.message.list({ path: { id: sessionID } })\n      // API returns Array<{ info: Message, parts: Array<Part> }>\n      const items = response.data ?? []\n\n      const lines = items.map((item: any) =>\n        JSON.stringify(formatMessageFromAPI(item.info, item.parts ?? []))\n      )\n      await Bun.write(transcriptPath, lines.join(\"\\n\") + \"\\n\")\n      return transcriptPath\n    } catch {\n      // API unavailable (likely shutting down) — fall back to in-memory stores\n      return writeTranscriptFromMemory(sessionID)\n    }\n  }\n\n  return {\n    event: async ({ event }) => {\n      switch (event.type) {\n        case \"session.created\": {\n          const session = (event as any).properties?.info\n          if (!session?.id) break\n          currentSessionID = session.id\n          await callHook(\"session-start\", {\n            session_id: session.id,\n            transcript_path: `${transcriptDir}/${session.id}.jsonl`,\n          })\n          break\n        }\n\n        case \"message.updated\": {\n          const msg = (event as any).properties?.info\n          if (!msg) break\n          // Store message metadata (role, time, tokens, etc.)\n          // Content is NOT on the message — it arrives via message.part.updated events.\n          messageStore.set(msg.id, msg)\n          break\n        }\n\n        case \"message.part.updated\": {\n          const part = (event as any).properties?.part\n          if (!part?.messageID) break\n\n          // Accumulate parts per message\n          const existing = partStore.get(part.messageID) ?? []\n          // Replace existing part with same id, or append new one\n          const idx = existing.findIndex((p: any) => p.id === part.id)\n          if (idx >= 0) {\n            existing[idx] = part\n          } else {\n            existing.push(part)\n          }\n          partStore.set(part.messageID, existing)\n\n          // Fire turn-start on the first text part of a new user message\n          const msg = messageStore.get(part.messageID)\n          if (msg?.role === \"user\" && part.type === \"text\" && !seenUserMessages.has(msg.id)) {\n            seenUserMessages.add(msg.id)\n            const sessionID = msg.sessionID ?? currentSessionID\n            if (sessionID) {\n              await callHook(\"turn-start\", {\n                session_id: sessionID,\n                transcript_path: `${transcriptDir}/${sessionID}.jsonl`,\n                prompt: part.text ?? \"\",\n              })\n            }\n          }\n          break\n        }\n\n        case \"session.idle\": {\n          const sessionID = (event as any).properties?.sessionID\n          if (!sessionID) break\n          const transcriptPath = await writeTranscriptWithFallback(sessionID)\n          await callHook(\"turn-end\", {\n            session_id: sessionID,\n            transcript_path: transcriptPath,\n          })\n          break\n        }\n\n        case \"session.compacted\": {\n          const sessionID = (event as any).properties?.sessionID\n          if (!sessionID) break\n          await callHook(\"compaction\", {\n            session_id: sessionID,\n            transcript_path: `${transcriptDir}/${sessionID}.jsonl`,\n          })\n          break\n        }\n\n        case \"session.deleted\": {\n          const session = (event as any).properties?.info\n          if (!session?.id) break\n          // Write final transcript before signaling session end\n          if (messageStore.size > 0) {\n            await writeTranscriptFromMemory(session.id)\n          }\n          seenUserMessages.clear()\n          messageStore.clear()\n          partStore.clear()\n          currentSessionID = null\n          await callHook(\"session-end\", {\n            session_id: session.id,\n            transcript_path: `${transcriptDir}/${session.id}.jsonl`,\n          })\n          break\n        }\n      }\n    },\n  }\n}\n"

   128→	return &agent.AgentSession{
   129→		AgentName:     a.Name(),
   130→		SessionID:     input.SessionID,
   131→		SessionRef:    input.SessionRef,
   132→		NativeData:    data,
   133→		ModifiedFiles: modifiedFiles,
   134→	}, nil
   135→}
   136→
   137→func (a *OpenCodeAgent) WriteSession(session *agent.AgentSession) error {
   138→	if session == nil {
   139→		return errors.New("nil session")
   140→	}
   141→	if session.SessionRef == "" {
   142→		return errors.New("no session ref to write to")
   143→	}
   144→	if len(session.NativeData) == 0 {
   145→		return errors.New("no session data to write")
   146→	}
   147→	dir := filepath.Dir(session.SessionRef)
   148→	//nolint:gosec // G301: Session directory needs standard permissions
   149→	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
   150→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session directory: %w", err)
   151→	}
   152→	if err := os.WriteFile(session.SessionRef, session.NativeData, 0o600); err != nil {
   153→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write session data: %w", err)
   154→	}
   155→	return nil
   156→}
   157→
   158→func (a *OpenCodeAgent) FormatResumeCommand(sessionID string) string {
   159→	return "opencode --session " + sessionID
   160→}
   161→
   162→// nonAlphanumericRegex matches any non-alphanumeric character.
   163→var nonAlphanumericRegex = regexp.MustCompile(`[^a-zA-Z0-9]`)
   164→
   165→// SanitizePathForOpenCode converts a path to a safe directory name.
   166→// Replaces any non-alphanumeric character with a dash (same approach as Claude/Gemini).
   167→func SanitizePathForOpenCode(path string) string {
   168→	return nonAlphanumericRegex.ReplaceAllString(path, "-")
   169→}

   174→// SliceFromMessage returns a JSON transcript containing only messages from startMessageIndex onward.
   175→// This is used by explain to scope a full transcript to a specific checkpoint's portion.
   176→func SliceFromMessage(data []byte, startMessageIndex int) []byte {
   177→	if len(data) == 0 || startMessageIndex <= 0 {
   178→		return data
   179→	}
   180→
   181→	t, err := ParseTranscript(data)
   182→	if err != nil {

   184→	}

   186→	if startMessageIndex >= len(t.Messages) {
   187→		return nil
   188→	}
   189→
   190→	scoped := &Transcript{
   191→		SessionID: t.SessionID,
   192→		Messages:  t.Messages[startMessageIndex:],
   193→	}
   194→
   195→	out, err := json.Marshal(scoped)
   196→	if err != nil {
   197→		return nil
   198→	}
   199→	return out
   200→}

   219→// CalculateTokenUsageFromBytes computes token usage from raw transcript bytes starting at the given message offset.
   220→// This is a package-level function used by the condensation path (which has bytes, not a file path).
   221→func CalculateTokenUsageFromBytes(data []byte, startMessageIndex int) *agent.TokenUsage {
   222→	t, err := ParseTranscript(data)
   223→	if err != nil || t == nil {
   224→		return &agent.TokenUsage{}
   225→	}
   226→
   227→	usage := &agent.TokenUsage{}
   228→	for i := startMessageIndex; i < len(t.Messages); i++ {
   229→		msg := t.Messages[i]
   230→		if msg.Role != roleAssistant || msg.Tokens == nil {
   231→			continue
   232→		}
   233→		usage.InputTokens += msg.Tokens.Input
   234→		usage.OutputTokens += msg.Tokens.Output
   235→		usage.CacheReadTokens += msg.Tokens.Cache.Read
   236→		usage.CacheCreationTokens += msg.Tokens.Cache.Write
   237→		usage.APICallCount++
   238→	}
   239→
   240→	return usage
   241→}

   243→// CalculateTokenUsage computes token usage from assistant messages starting at the given offset.
   244→func (a *OpenCodeAgent) CalculateTokenUsage(sessionRef string, fromOffset int) (*agent.TokenUsage, error) {
   245→	t, err := parseTranscriptFile(sessionRef)
   246→	if err != nil {

   248→			return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil // nil usage for nonexistent file is expected
   249→		}
   250→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript for token usage: %w", err)
   251→	}
   252→
   253→	usage := &agent.TokenUsage{}
   254→	for i := fromOffset; i < len(t.Messages); i++ {
   255→		msg := t.Messages[i]
   256→		if msg.Role != roleAssistant || msg.Tokens == nil {
   257→			continue
   258→		}
   259→		usage.InputTokens += msg.Tokens.Input
   260→		usage.OutputTokens += msg.Tokens.Output
   261→		usage.CacheReadTokens += msg.Tokens.Cache.Read
   262→		usage.CacheCreationTokens += msg.Tokens.Cache.Write
   263→		usage.APICallCount++
   264→	}
   265→
   266→	return usage, nil
   267→}

   133→// buildCondensedTranscriptFromGemini parses Gemini JSON transcript and extracts a condensed view.
   134→func buildCondensedTranscriptFromGemini(content []byte) ([]Entry, error) {
   135→	geminiTranscript, err := geminicli.ParseTranscript(content)

   145→				entries = append(entries, Entry{
   146→					Type:    EntryTypeUser,
   147→					Content: msg.Content,
   148→				})
   149→			}
   150→		case geminicli.MessageTypeGemini:
   151→			// Add assistant content
   152→			if msg.Content != "" {
   153→				entries = append(entries, Entry{
   154→					Type:    EntryTypeAssistant,
   155→					Content: msg.Content,
   156→				})
   157→			}
   158→			// Add tool calls
   159→			for _, tc := range msg.ToolCalls {
   160→				entries = append(entries, Entry{
   161→					Type:       EntryTypeTool,
   162→					ToolName:   tc.Name,
   163→					ToolDetail: extractGenericToolDetail(tc.Args),
   164→				})
   165→			}
   166→		}
   167→	}
   168→
   169→	return entries, nil
   170→}

    15→// ParseFromBytes parses transcript content from a byte slice.
    16→// Uses bufio.Reader to handle arbitrarily long lines.
    17→func ParseFromBytes(content []byte) ([]Line, error) {
    18→	var lines []Line
    19→	reader := bufio.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(content))
    20→
    21→	for {
    22→		lineBytes, err := reader.ReadBytes('\n')
    23→		if err != nil && err != io.EOF {
    24→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read transcript: %w", err)
    25→		}
    26→
    27→		// Handle empty line or EOF without content
    28→		if len(lineBytes) == 0 {
    29→			if err == io.EOF {
    30→				break
    31→			}
    32→			continue
    33→		}
    34→
    35→		var line Line
    36→		if err := json.Unmarshal(lineBytes, &line); err == nil {
    37→			lines = append(lines, line)
    38→		}
    39→
    40→		if err == io.EOF {
    41→			break
    42→		}
    43→	}
    44→
    45→	return lines, nil
    46→}
    47→
    48→// ParseFromFileAtLine reads and parses a transcript file starting from a specific line.
    49→// Uses bufio.Reader to handle arbitrarily long lines (no size limit).
    50→// Returns:
    51→//   - lines: parsed transcript lines from startLine onwards (malformed lines skipped)
    52→//   - totalLines: total number of lines in the file (including malformed ones)
    53→//   - error: any error encountered during reading
    54→//
    55→// The startLine parameter is 0-indexed (startLine=0 reads from the beginning).
    56→// This is useful for incremental parsing when you've already processed some lines.
    57→func ParseFromFileAtLine(path string, startLine int) ([]Line, int, error) {
    58→	file, err := os.Open(path) //nolint:gosec // path is a controlled transcript file path
    59→	if err != nil {
    60→		return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to open transcript: %w", err)
    61→	}
    62→	defer func() { _ = file.Close() }()
    63→
    64→	var lines []Line
    65→	reader := bufio.NewReader(file)
    66→
    67→	totalLines := 0
    68→	for {
    69→		lineBytes, err := reader.ReadBytes('\n')
    70→		if err != nil && err != io.EOF {
    71→			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to read transcript: %w", err)
    72→		}
    73→
    74→		// Handle empty line or EOF without content
    75→		if len(lineBytes) == 0 {
    76→			if err == io.EOF {
    77→				break
    78→			}
    79→			continue
    80→		}
    81→
    82→		// Count all lines for totalLines, but only parse after startLine
    83→		if totalLines >= startLine {
    84→			var line Line
    85→			if err := json.Unmarshal(lineBytes, &line); err == nil {
    86→				lines = append(lines, line)
    87→			}
    88→		}
    89→		totalLines++
    90→
    91→		if err == io.EOF {
    92→			break
    93→		}
    94→	}
    95→
    96→	return lines, totalLines, nil
    97→}
    98→
    99→// SliceFromLine returns the content starting from line number `startLine` (0-indexed).
   100→// This is used to extract only the checkpoint-specific portion of a cumulative transcript.
   101→// For example, if startLine is 2, lines 0 and 1 are skipped and the result starts at line 2.
   102→// Returns empty slice if startLine exceeds the number of lines.
   103→func SliceFromLine(content []byte, startLine int) []byte {
   104→	if len(content) == 0 || startLine <= 0 {
   105→		return content
   106→	}
   107→
   108→	// Find the byte offset where startLine begins
   109→	lineCount := 0
   110→	offset := 0
   111→	for i, b := range content {
   112→		if b == '\n' {
   113→			lineCount++
   114→			if lineCount == startLine {
   115→				offset = i + 1
   116→				break
   117→			}
   118→		}
   119→	}
   120→
   121→	// If we didn't find enough lines, return empty
   122→	if lineCount < startLine {
   123→		return nil
   124→	}
   125→
   126→	// If offset is beyond content, return empty
   127→	if offset >= len(content) {
   128→		return nil
   129→	}
   130→
   131→	return content[offset:]
   132→}

   137→// Returns empty string if the message cannot be parsed or contains no text.
   138→func ExtractUserContent(message json.RawMessage) string {

jsonErr == nil {\n\t\t\t\tmessages = append(messages, msg)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif err == io.EOF {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn messages, nil\n}\n\n// parseMessagesFromFile reads and parses a JSONL transcript file.\nfunc parseMessagesFromFile(path string) ([]Message, error) {\n\tdata, err := os.ReadFile(path) //nolint:gosec // Path from agent hook\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err //nolint:wrapcheck // Callers check os.IsNotExist on this error\n\t}\n\treturn ParseMessages(data)\n}\n\n// GetTranscriptPosition returns the number of JSONL lines in the transcript.\nfunc (a *OpenCodeAgent) GetTranscriptPosition(path string) (int, error) {\n\tmessages, err := parseMessagesFromFile(path)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tif os.IsNotExist(err) {\n\t\t\treturn 0, nil\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn 0, err\n\t}\n\treturn len(messages), nil\n}\n\n// ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset extracts files modified by tool calls from the given message offset.\nfunc (a *OpenCodeAgent) ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset(path string, startOffset int) ([]string, int, error) {\n\tmessages, err := parseMessagesFromFile(path)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tif os.IsNotExist(err) {\n\t\t\treturn nil, 0, nil\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn nil, 0, err\n\t}\n\n\tseen := make(map[string]bool)\n\tvar files []string\n\n\tfor i := startOffset; i < len(messages); i++ {\n\t\tmsg := messages[i]\n\t\tif msg.Role != roleAssistant {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor _, part := range msg.Parts {\n\t\t\tif part.Type != \"tool\" || part.State == nil {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif !slices.Contains(FileModificationTools, part.Tool) {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tfilePath := extractFilePathFromInput(part.State.Input)\n\t\t\tif filePath != \"\" && !seen[filePath] {\n\t\t\t\tseen[filePath] = true\n\t\t\t\tfiles = append(files, filePath)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn files, len(messages), nil\n}\n\n// ExtractModifiedFiles extracts modified file paths from raw JSONL transcript bytes.\n// This is the bytes-based equivalent of ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset, used by ReadSession.\nfunc ExtractModifiedFiles(data []byte) ([]string, error) {\n\tmessages, err := ParseMessages(data)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tseen := make(map[string]bool)\n\tvar files []string\n\n\tfor _, msg := range messages {\n\t\tif msg.Role != roleAssistant {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor _, part := range msg.Parts {\n\t\t\tif part.Type != \"tool\" || part.State == nil {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif !slices.Contains(FileModificationTools, part.Tool) {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tfilePath := extractFilePathFromInput(part.State.Input)\n\t\t\tif filePath != \"\" && !seen[filePath] {\n\t\t\t\tseen[filePath] = true\n\t\t\t\tfiles = append(files, filePath)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn files, nil\n}\n\n// extractFilePathFromInput extracts the file path from a tool's input map.\nfunc extractFilePathFromInput(input map[string]interface{}) string {\n\tfor _, key := range []string{\"file_path\", \"path\", \"file\", \"filename\"} {\n\t\tif v, ok := input[key]; ok {\n\t\t\tif s, ok := v.(string); ok && s != \"\" {\n\t\t\t\treturn s\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn \"\"\n}\n\n// ExtractPrompts extracts user prompt strings from the transcript starting at the given offset.\nfunc (a *OpenCodeAgent) ExtractPrompts(sessionRef string, fromOffset int) ([]string, error) {\n\tmessages, err := parseMessagesFromFile(sessionRef)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tif os.IsNotExist(err) {\n\t\t\treturn nil, nil\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tvar prompts []string\n\tfor i := fromOffset; i < len(messages); i++ {\n\t\tmsg := messages[i]\n\t\tif msg.Role == roleUser && msg.Content != \"\" {\n\t\t\tprompts = append(prompts, msg.Content)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn prompts, nil\n}\n\n// ExtractSummary extracts the last assistant message content as a summary.\nfunc (a *OpenCodeAgent) ExtractSummary(sessionRef string) (string, error) {\n\tmessages, err := parseMessagesFromFile(sessionRef)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tif os.IsNotExist(err) {\n\t\t\treturn \"\", nil\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn \"\", err\n\t}\n\n\tfor i := len(messages) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {\n\t\tmsg := messages[i]\n\t\tif msg.Role == roleAssistant && msg.Content != \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn msg.Content, nil\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn \"\", nil\n}\n\n// ExtractAllUserPrompts extracts all user prompts from raw JSONL transcript bytes.\n// This is a package-level function used by the condensation path.\nfunc ExtractAllUserPrompts(data []byte) ([]string, error) {\n\tmessages, err := ParseMessages(data)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tvar prompts []string\n\tfor _, msg := range messages {\n\t\tif msg.Role == roleUser && msg.Content != \"\" {\n\t\t\tprompts = append(prompts, msg.Content)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn prompts, nil\n}\n\n// CalculateTokenUsageFromBytes computes token usage from raw JSONL transcript bytes\n// starting at the given message offset.\n// This is a package-level function used by the condensation path (which has bytes, not a file path).\nfunc CalculateTokenUsageFromBytes(data []byte, startMessageIndex int) *agent.TokenUsage {\n\tmessages, err := ParseMessages(data)\n\tif err != nil || messages == nil {\n\t\treturn &agent.TokenUsage{}\n\t}\n\n\tusage := &agent.TokenUsage{}\n\tfor i := startMessageIndex; i < len(messages); i++ {\n\t\tmsg := messages[i]\n\t\tif msg.Role != roleAssistant || msg.Tokens == nil {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tusage.InputTokens += msg.Tokens.Input\n\t\tusage.OutputTokens += msg.Tokens.Output\n\t\tusage.CacheReadTokens += msg.Tokens.Cache.Read\n\t\tusage.CacheCreationTokens += msg.Tokens.Cache.Write\n\t\tusage.APICallCount++\n\t}\n\n\treturn usage\n}\n\n// CalculateTokenUsage computes token usage from assistant messages starting at the given offset.\nfunc (a *OpenCodeAgent) CalculateTokenUsage(sessionRef string, fromOffset int) (*agent.TokenUsage, error) {\n\tmessages, err := parseMessagesFromFile(sessionRef)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tif os.IsNotExist(err) {\n\t\t\treturn nil, nil //nolint:nilnil // nil usage for nonexistent file is expected\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to parse transcript for token usage: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tusage := &agent.TokenUsage{}\n\tfor i := fromOffset; i < len(messages); i++ {\n\t\tmsg := messages[i]\n\t\tif msg.Role != roleAssistant || msg.Tokens == nil {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tusage.InputTokens += msg.Tokens.Input\n\t\tusage.OutputTokens += msg.Tokens.Output\n\t\tusage.CacheReadTokens += msg.Tokens.Cache.Read\n\t\tusage.CacheCreationTokens += msg.Tokens.Cache.Write\n\t\tusage.APICallCount++\n\t}\n\n\treturn usage, nil\n}\n\n// countLines counts the number of non-empty lines in JSONL content.\nfunc countLines(content string) int {\n\tif content == \"\" {\n\t\treturn 0\n\t}\n\tlines := strings.Split(content, \"\\n\")\n\tcount := 0\n\tfor _, line := range lines {\n\t\tif strings.TrimSpace(line) != \"\" {\n\t\t\tcount++\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn count\n}\n"
}

    61→func writeTestTranscript(t *testing.T, content string) string {
    62→	t.Helper()
    63→	dir := t.TempDir()
    64→	path := filepath.Join(dir, "test-session.json")
    65→	if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(content), 0o644); err != nil {
    66→		t.Fatalf("failed to write test transcript: %v", err)
    67→	}
    68→	return path
    69→}

   368→func TestChunkTranscript_RoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
   369→	t.Parallel()
   370→	ag := &OpenCodeAgent{}

   375→	if err != nil {

   378→
   379→	// Reassemble
   380→	reassembled, err := ag.ReassembleTranscript(chunks)
   381→	if err != nil {
   382→		t.Fatalf("reassemble error: %v", err)
   383→	}
   384→
   385→	// Parse both and compare messages
   386→	original, parseErr := ParseTranscript(content)
   387→	if parseErr != nil {
   388→		t.Fatalf("failed to parse original: %v", parseErr)
   389→	}
   390→	result, parseErr := ParseTranscript(reassembled)
   391→	if parseErr != nil {
   392→		t.Fatalf("failed to parse reassembled: %v", parseErr)
   393→	}
   394→
   395→	if result.SessionID != original.SessionID {
   396→		t.Errorf("session_id mismatch: %q vs %q", result.SessionID, original.SessionID)
   397→	}
   398→	if len(result.Messages) != len(original.Messages) {
   399→		t.Fatalf("message count mismatch: %d vs %d", len(result.Messages), len(original.Messages))
   400→	}
   401→	for i, msg := range result.Messages {
   402→		if msg.ID != original.Messages[i].ID {
   403→			t.Errorf("message %d: ID mismatch %q vs %q", i, msg.ID, original.Messages[i].ID)
   404→		}
   405→	}
   406→}

The JSONL conversion is complete. Here's a summary of all changes made:

**Core changes:**
- **`opencode.go`** — Removed unused `encoding/json` import, fixed `ReassembleTranscript` return (`ReassembleJSONL` returns `[]byte`, not `([]byte, error)`), wrapped `ChunkJSONL` error
- **`transcript.go`** — Full rewrite: replaced `ParseTranscript`/`Transcript` (JSON blob) with `ParseMessages` (JSONL line-by-line parsing using `bufio.Reader`). Removed `SliceFromMessage` (line-based slicing via `transcript.SliceFromLine` now handles OpenCode too)
- **`entire_plugin.ts`** — Already converted to JSONL in prior session (writes one message per line)
- **`types.go`** — `Transcript` struct already removed in prior session

**Downstream consumer changes:**
- **`explain.go`** — Removed OpenCode-specific cases from `scopeTranscriptForCheckpoint` and `transcriptOffset` — OpenCode now falls through to the shared JSONL path (line-based slicing/counting). Removed unused `opencode` import.
- **`manual_commit_condensation.go`** — Removed OpenCode case from `countTranscriptItems` (falls through to JSONL line-counting). Kept OpenCode-specific branches in `extractUserPrompts` and `calculateTokenUsage` (different per-line schema), updated comments.
- **`summarize.go`** — Updated `buildCondensedTranscriptFromOpenCode` to use `ParseMessages` instead of `ParseTranscript`

**Test changes:**
- **`transcript_test.go`** — Rewrote fixtures from JSON blob to JSONL. Removed `SliceFromMessage`/`ParseTranscript` tests. Added `ParseMessages` tests. Fixed chunk maxSize (400-byte JSONL lines need >350 limit).
- **`summarize_test.go`** — Converted 4 OpenCode test fixtures from JSON to JSONL. Updated invalid-input test to match JSONL semantics (invalid lines silently skipped, not error).

what where the other things you found in review?

> AGENT

From the original review, beyond the three things we fixed (transcript path, tool names, JSON→JSONL), the remaining findings were:

1. **`session.error` event not handled** — The plugin handles `session.created`, `message.updated`, `message.part.updated`, `session.idle`, `session.compacted`, `session.deleted` but not `session.error`. If OpenCode emits an error event, it's silently ignored.

2. **`FormatResumeCommand` uses unverified flag** — `opencode.go:159` returns `"opencode --session " + sessionID` but I couldn't verify that `--session` is an actual OpenCode CLI flag. If it's wrong, the resume hint shown to users would be misleading.

3. **No integration tests** — Claude Code and Gemini have integration tests in `cmd/entire/cli/integration_test/` that simulate hook flows (session-start → turn-start → turn-end → commit → session-end). OpenCode has none, so the full hook→checkpoint→condense pipeline is untested.

4. **Dead code after switch statements in `explain.go`** — There were unreachable `return` statements after exhaustive switch cases. We cleaned up the OpenCode cases but there may still be redundant fallthrough returns.

5. **`removeAgentHooks` in `setup.go` is hardcoded per-agent** — When uninstalling, the code has a manual list of agents to clean up rather than iterating the registry. Adding a new agent requires remembering to update this.

Want me to dig into any of these?

    46→type TestEnv struct {

    50→	GeminiProjectDir string

    54→// NewTestEnv creates a new isolated test environment.
    55→// It creates temp directories for the git repo and agent project files.
    56→// Note: Does NOT change working directory to allow parallel test execution.
    57→// Note: Does NOT use t.Setenv to allow parallel test execution - CLI commands
    58→// receive the env var via cmd.Env instead.
    59→func NewTestEnv(t *testing.T) *TestEnv {
    60→	t.Helper()
    61→
    62→	// Resolve symlinks on macOS where /var -> /private/var
    63→	// This ensures the CLI subprocess and test use consistent paths
    64→	repoDir := t.TempDir()
    65→	if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(repoDir); err == nil {
    66→		repoDir = resolved
    67→	}
    68→	claudeProjectDir := t.TempDir()
    69→	if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(claudeProjectDir); err == nil {
    70→		claudeProjectDir = resolved
    71→	}
    72→	geminiProjectDir := t.TempDir()
    73→	if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(geminiProjectDir); err == nil {
    74→		geminiProjectDir = resolved
    75→	}
    76→
    77→	env := &TestEnv{
    78→		T:                t,
    79→		RepoDir:          repoDir,
    80→		ClaudeProjectDir: claudeProjectDir,
    81→		GeminiProjectDir: geminiProjectDir,
    82→	}
    83→
    84→	// Note: Don't use t.Setenv here - it's incompatible with t.Parallel()
    85→	// CLI commands receive ENTIRE_TEST_CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR or ENTIRE_TEST_GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR via cmd.Env instead
    86→
    87→	return env
    88→}

   256→
   257→// CreateTranscript builds and writes a transcript for the session.
   258→func (s *Session) CreateTranscript(prompt string, changes []FileChange) string {
   259→	s.TranscriptBuilder.AddUserMessage(prompt)
   260→	s.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("I'll help you with that.")
   261→
   262→	for _, change := range changes {
   263→		toolID := s.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolUse("mcp__acp__Write", change.Path, change.Content)
   264→		s.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolResult(toolID)
   265→	}
   266→
   267→	s.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("Done!")
   268→
   269→	if err := s.TranscriptBuilder.WriteToFile(s.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   270→		s.env.T.Fatalf("failed to write transcript: %v", err)
   271→	}
   272→
   273→	return s.TranscriptPath
   274→}

   488→	stateFile := filepath.Join(stateDir, sessionID+".json")
   489→
   490→	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(state, "", "  ")
   491→	if err != nil {
   492→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal session state: %w", err)
   493→	}
   494→
   495→	if err := os.WriteFile(stateFile, data, 0o644); err != nil {
   496→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write session state: %w", err)
   497→	}
   498→	return nil
   499→}

   501→// GeminiHookRunner executes Gemini CLI hooks in the test environment.
   502→type GeminiHookRunner struct {
   503→	RepoDir          string
   504→	GeminiProjectDir string
   505→	T                interface {
   506→		Helper()
   507→		Fatalf(format string, args ...interface{})
   508→		Logf(format string, args ...interface{})
   509→	}
   510→}
   511→
   512→// NewGeminiHookRunner creates a new Gemini hook runner for the given repo directory.
   513→func NewGeminiHookRunner(repoDir, geminiProjectDir string, t interface {
   514→	Helper()
   515→	Fatalf(format string, args ...interface{})
   516→	Logf(format string, args ...interface{})
   517→}) *GeminiHookRunner {
   518→	return &GeminiHookRunner{
   519→		RepoDir:          repoDir,
   520→		GeminiProjectDir: geminiProjectDir,
   521→		T:                t,
   522→	}
   523→}
   524→
   525→// runGeminiHookWithInput runs a Gemini hook with the given input.
   526→func (r *GeminiHookRunner) runGeminiHookWithInput(hookName string, input interface{}) error {
   527→	r.T.Helper()
   528→
   529→	inputJSON, err := json.Marshal(input)
   530→	if err != nil {
   531→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal hook input: %w", err)
   532→	}
   533→
   534→	return r.runGeminiHookInRepoDir(hookName, inputJSON)
   535→}
   536→
   537→func (r *GeminiHookRunner) runGeminiHookInRepoDir(hookName string, inputJSON []byte) error {
   538→	// Run using the shared test binary
   539→	// Command structure: entire hooks gemini <hook-name>
   540→	cmd := exec.Command(getTestBinary(), "hooks", "gemini", hookName)
   541→	cmd.Dir = r.RepoDir
   542→	cmd.Stdin = bytes.NewReader(inputJSON)
   543→	cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(),
   544→		"ENTIRE_TEST_GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR="+r.GeminiProjectDir,
   545→	)
   546→
   547→	output, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
   548→	if err != nil {
   549→		return fmt.Errorf("hook %s failed: %w\nInput: %s\nOutput: %s",
   550→			hookName, err, inputJSON, output)
   551→	}
   552→
   553→	r.T.Logf("Gemini hook %s output: %s", hookName, output)
   554→	return nil
   555→}
   556→
   557→// runGeminiHookWithOutput runs a Gemini hook and returns both stdout and stderr separately.
   558→func (r *GeminiHookRunner) runGeminiHookWithOutput(hookName string, inputJSON []byte) HookOutput {
   559→	cmd := exec.Command(getTestBinary(), "hooks", "gemini", hookName)
   560→	cmd.Dir = r.RepoDir
   561→	cmd.Stdin = bytes.NewReader(inputJSON)
   562→	cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(),
   563→		"ENTIRE_TEST_GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR="+r.GeminiProjectDir,
   564→	)
   565→
   566→	var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
   567→	cmd.Stdout = &stdout
   568→	cmd.Stderr = &stderr
   569→
   570→	err := cmd.Run()
   571→	return HookOutput{
   572→		Stdout: stdout.Bytes(),
   573→		Stderr: stderr.Bytes(),
   574→		Err:    err,
   575→	}
   576→}

   578→// SimulateGeminiBeforeAgent simulates the BeforeAgent hook for Gemini CLI.
   579→// This is equivalent to Claude Code's UserPromptSubmit.
   580→func (r *GeminiHookRunner) SimulateGeminiBeforeAgent(sessionID string) error {
   581→	r.T.Helper()
   582→
   583→	input := map[string]string{

   649→// GeminiSession represents a simulated Gemini CLI session.
   650→type GeminiSession struct {
   651→	ID             string // Raw model session ID (e.g., "gemini-session-1")
   652→	TranscriptPath string
   653→	env            *TestEnv
   654→}
   655→
   656→// NewGeminiSession creates a new simulated Gemini session.
   657→func (env *TestEnv) NewGeminiSession() *GeminiSession {
   658→	env.T.Helper()
   659→
   660→	env.SessionCounter++
   661→	sessionID := fmt.Sprintf("gemini-session-%d", env.SessionCounter)
   662→	transcriptPath := filepath.Join(env.RepoDir, ".entire", "tmp", sessionID+".json")
   663→
   664→	return &GeminiSession{
   665→		ID:             sessionID,
   666→		TranscriptPath: transcriptPath,
   667→		env:            env,
   668→	}
   669→}
   670→
   671→// CreateGeminiTranscript creates a Gemini JSON transcript file for the session.
   672→func (s *GeminiSession) CreateGeminiTranscript(prompt string, changes []FileChange) string {
   673→	// Build Gemini-format transcript (JSON, not JSONL)
   674→	messages := []map[string]interface{}{
   675→		{
   676→			"type":    "user",
   677→			"content": prompt,
   678→		},
   679→		{
   680→			"type":    "assistant",
   681→			"content": "I'll help you with that.",
   682→		},
   683→	}
   684→
   685→	for _, change := range changes {
   686→		messages = append(messages, map[string]interface{}{
   687→			"type": "tool_use",
   688→			"name": "write_file",
   689→			"input": map[string]string{
   690→				"path":    change.Path,
   691→				"content": change.Content,
   692→			},
   693→		})
   694→		messages = append(messages, map[string]interface{}{
   695→			"type":   "tool_result",
   696→			"output": "File written successfully",
   697→		})
   698→	}
   699→
   700→	messages = append(messages, map[string]interface{}{
   701→		"type":    "assistant",
   702→		"content": "Done!",
   703→	})
   704→
   705→	transcript := map[string]interface{}{
   706→		"sessionId": s.ID,
   707→		"messages":  messages,
   708→	}
   709→
   710→	// Ensure directory exists
   711→	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(s.TranscriptPath), 0o755); err != nil {
   712→		s.env.T.Fatalf("failed to create transcript dir: %v", err)
   713→	}
   714→
   715→	// Write transcript
   716→	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(transcript, "", "  ")
   717→	if err != nil {
   718→		s.env.T.Fatalf("failed to marshal transcript: %v", err)
   719→	}
   720→	if err := os.WriteFile(s.TranscriptPath, data, 0o644); err != nil {
   721→		s.env.T.Fatalf("failed to write transcript: %v", err)
   722→	}
   723→
   724→	return s.TranscriptPath
   725→}

   153→// WriteToFile writes the transcript to a JSONL file.
   154→func (b *TranscriptBuilder) WriteToFile(path string) error {
   155→	// Ensure directory exists
   156→	dir := filepath.Dir(path)
   157→	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
   158→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create directory: %w", err)
   159→	}
   160→
   161→	file, err := os.Create(path)
   162→	if err != nil {
   163→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create file: %w", err)
   164→	}
   165→	defer func() { _ = file.Close() }()
   166→
   167→	encoder := json.NewEncoder(file)
   168→	for _, msg := range b.messages {
   169→		if err := encoder.Encode(msg); err != nil {
   170→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to encode message: %w", err)
   171→		}
   172→	}
   173→	return nil
   174→}
   175→
   176→// String returns the transcript as a JSONL string.
   177→func (b *TranscriptBuilder) String() string {
   178→	var result string
   179→	var resultSb176 strings.Builder
   180→	for _, msg := range b.messages {
   181→		data, _ := json.Marshal(msg)
   182→		resultSb176.WriteString(string(data) + "\n")
   183→	}
   184→	result += resultSb176.String()
   185→	return result
   186→}

   189→func (b *TranscriptBuilder) LastUUID() string {
   190→	if len(b.messages) == 0 {
   191→		return ""
   192→	}
   193→	return b.messages[len(b.messages)-1]["uuid"].(string)
   194→}

    89→// TestAgentHookInstallation verifies hook installation via agent interface.
    90→// Note: These tests cannot run in parallel because they use os.Chdir which affects the entire process.
    91→func TestAgentHookInstallation(t *testing.T) {
    92→	// Not parallel - tests use os.Chdir which is process-global
    93→
    94→	t.Run("installs all required hooks", func(t *testing.T) {
    95→		// Not parallel - uses os.Chdir
    96→		env := NewTestEnv(t)
    97→		env.InitRepo()
    98→
    99→		// Change to repo dir
   100→		oldWd, _ := os.Getwd()
   101→		if err := os.Chdir(env.RepoDir); err != nil {
   102→			t.Fatalf("failed to chdir: %v", err)
   103→		}
   104→		defer func() { _ = os.Chdir(oldWd) }()
   105→
   106→		ag, err := agent.Get("claude-code")
   107→		if err != nil {
   108→			t.Fatalf("Get(claude-code) error = %v", err)
   109→		}
   110→
   111→		hookAgent, ok := ag.(agent.HookSupport)
   112→		if !ok {
   113→			t.Fatal("claude-code agent does not implement HookSupport")
   114→		}
   115→
   116→		count, err := hookAgent.InstallHooks(false, false)
   117→		if err != nil {
   118→			t.Fatalf("InstallHooks() error = %v", err)
   119→		}
   120→
   121→		// Should install 7 hooks: SessionStart, SessionEnd, Stop, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse[Task], PostToolUse[Task], PostToolUse[TodoWrite]
   122→		if count != 7 {
   123→			t.Errorf("InstallHooks() count = %d, want 7", count)
   124→		}
   125→
   126→		// Verify hooks are installed
   127→		if !hookAgent.AreHooksInstalled() {
   128→			t.Error("AreHooksInstalled() = false after InstallHooks()")
   129→		}
   130→
   131→		// Verify settings.json was created
   132→		settingsPath := filepath.Join(env.RepoDir, ".claude", claudecode.ClaudeSettingsFileName)
   133→		if _, err := os.Stat(settingsPath); os.IsNotExist(err) {
   134→			t.Error("settings.json was not created")
   135→		}
   136→
   137→		// Verify permissions.deny contains metadata deny rule
   138→		data, err := os.ReadFile(settingsPath)
   139→		if err != nil {
   140→			t.Fatalf("failed to read settings.json: %v", err)
   141→		}
   142→		content := string(data)
   143→		if !strings.Contains(content, "Read(./.entire/metadata/**)") {
   144→			t.Error("settings.json should contain permissions.deny rule for .entire/metadata/**")
   145→		}
   146→	})

   148→	t.Run("idempotent - second install returns 0", func(t *testing.T) {

   211→// TestAgentSessionOperations verifies ReadSession/WriteSession via agent interface.
   212→func TestAgentSessionOperations(t *testing.T) {
   213→	t.Parallel()
   214→
   215→	t.Run("ReadSession parses transcript and computes ModifiedFiles", func(t *testing.T) {
   216→		t.Parallel()
   217→		env := NewTestEnv(t)
   218→		env.InitRepo()
   219→
   220→		// Create a transcript file
   221→		transcriptPath := filepath.Join(env.RepoDir, "test-transcript.jsonl")
   222→		transcriptContent := `{"type":"user","uuid":"u1","message":{"content":"Fix the bug"}}
   223→{"type":"assistant","uuid":"a1","message":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"I'll fix it"},{"type":"tool_use","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"main.go"}}]}}
   224→{"type":"user","uuid":"u2","message":{"content":[{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"a1"}]}}
   225→{"type":"assistant","uuid":"a2","message":{"content":[{"type":"tool_use","name":"Edit","input":{"file_path":"util.go"}}]}}
   226→`
   227→		if err := os.WriteFile(transcriptPath, []byte(transcriptContent), 0o644); err != nil {
   228→			t.Fatalf("failed to write transcript: %v", err)
   229→		}
   230→
   231→		ag, _ := agent.Get("claude-code")
   232→		session, err := ag.ReadSession(&agent.HookInput{
   233→			SessionID:  "test-session",
   234→			SessionRef: transcriptPath,
   235→		})
   236→		if err != nil {
   237→			t.Fatalf("ReadSession() error = %v", err)
   238→		}
   239→
   240→		// Verify session metadata
   241→		if session.SessionID != "test-session" {
   242→			t.Errorf("SessionID = %q, want %q", session.SessionID, "test-session")
   243→		}
   244→		if session.AgentName != "claude-code" {
   245→			t.Errorf("AgentName = %q, want %q", session.AgentName, "claude-code")
   246→		}
   247→
   248→		// Verify NativeData is populated
   249→		if len(session.NativeData) == 0 {
   250→			t.Error("NativeData is empty, want transcript content")
   251→		}
   252→
   253→		// Verify ModifiedFiles computed
   254→		if len(session.ModifiedFiles) != 2 {
   255→			t.Errorf("ModifiedFiles = %v, want 2 files (main.go, util.go)", session.ModifiedFiles)
   256→		}
   257→	})
   258→
   259→	t.Run("WriteSession writes NativeData to file", func(t *testing.T) {
   260→		t.Parallel()
   261→		env := NewTestEnv(t)
   262→		env.InitRepo()
   263→
   264→		ag, _ := agent.Get("claude-code")
   265→
   266→		// First read a session
   267→		srcPath := filepath.Join(env.RepoDir, "src.jsonl")
   268→		srcContent := `{"type":"user","uuid":"u1","message":{"content":"hello"}}
   269→`
   270→		if err := os.WriteFile(srcPath, []byte(srcContent), 0o644); err != nil {
   271→			t.Fatalf("failed to write source: %v", err)
   272→		}
   273→
   274→		session, _ := ag.ReadSession(&agent.HookInput{
   275→			SessionID:  "test",
   276→			SessionRef: srcPath,
   277→		})
   278→
   279→		// Write to a new location
   280→		dstPath := filepath.Join(env.RepoDir, "dst.jsonl")
   281→		session.SessionRef = dstPath
   282→
   283→		if err := ag.WriteSession(session); err != nil {
   284→			t.Fatalf("WriteSession() error = %v", err)
   285→		}
   286→
   287→		// Verify file was written
   288→		data, err := os.ReadFile(dstPath)
   289→		if err != nil {
   290→			t.Fatalf("failed to read destination: %v", err)
   291→		}
   292→		if string(data) != srcContent {
   293→			t.Errorf("written content = %q, want %q", string(data), srcContent)
   294→		}
   295→	})
   296→
   297→	t.Run("WriteSession rejects wrong agent", func(t *testing.T) {
   298→		t.Parallel()
   299→
   300→		ag, _ := agent.Get("claude-code")
   301→
   302→		session := &agent.AgentSession{
   303→			SessionID:  "test",
   304→			AgentName:  "other-agent", // Wrong agent
   305→			SessionRef: "/tmp/test.jsonl",
   306→			NativeData: []byte("data"),
   307→		}
   308→
   309→		err := ag.WriteSession(session)
   310→		if err == nil {
   311→			t.Error("WriteSession() should reject session from different agent")
   312→		}
   313→	})
   314→}

   475→func TestGeminiCLIHookInstallation(t *testing.T) {
   476→	// Not parallel - tests use os.Chdir which is process-global
   477→
   478→	t.Run("installs all required hooks", func(t *testing.T) {

   543→			t.Error("settings.json should contain BeforeModel hook")
   544→		}

   107→func TestAgentTranscriptRestoration(t *testing.T) {
   108→	t.Parallel()
   109→
   110→	// Only test with manual-commit strategy as it has full transcript restoration
   111→	env := NewFeatureBranchEnv(t, strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)

   114→
   115→	// Create first session

   119→		{Path: "file1.go", Content: "package main\n// file1 v1"},
   120→	})
   121→
   122→	env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session1.ID)
   123→	env.SimulateStop(session1.ID, transcript1)
   124→
   125→	// Get checkpoint after first prompt
   126→	points1 := env.GetRewindPoints()
   127→	if len(points1) == 0 {
   128→		t.Fatal("no rewind point after first prompt")
   129→	}
   130→	checkpoint1ID := points1[0].ID
   131→
   132→	// Continue the SAME session with second prompt (manual-commit strategy requires same session on same base commit)
   133→	// Reset transcript builder for the new checkpoint
   134→	session1.TranscriptBuilder = NewTranscriptBuilder()
   135→	env.WriteFile("file1.go", "package main\n// file1 v2")
   136→	env.WriteFile("file2.go", "package main\n// file2")
   137→	transcript2 := session1.CreateTranscript("Modify file1, create file2", []FileChange{
   138→		{Path: "file1.go", Content: "package main\n// file1 v2"},
   139→		{Path: "file2.go", Content: "package main\n// file2"},
   140→	})

   142→	env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session1.ID)
   143→	env.SimulateStop(session1.ID, transcript2)
   144→
   145→	// Verify we have 2 checkpoints

   147→	if len(points2) < 2 {

   155→
   156→	// Verify file content is restored

   162→	// file2.go should not exist after rewind to checkpoint 1

   314→// stringReader implements io.Reader for test strings
   315→type stringReader struct {
   316→	data []byte
   317→	pos  int
   318→}
   319→
   320→func newStringReader(s string) *stringReader {
   321→	return &stringReader{data: []byte(s)}
   322→}
   323→
   324→func (r *stringReader) Read(p []byte) (n int, err error) {
   325→	if r.pos >= len(r.data) {
   326→		return 0, io.EOF
   327→	}
   328→	n = copy(p, r.data[r.pos:])
   329→	r.pos += n
   330→	return n, nil
   331→}

    45→// TestEnv manages an isolated test environment for integration tests.
    46→type TestEnv struct {

    54→// NewTestEnv creates a new isolated test environment.
    55→// It creates temp directories for the git repo and agent project files.
    56→// Note: Does NOT change working directory to allow parallel test execution.
    57→// Note: Does NOT use t.Setenv to allow parallel test execution - CLI commands
    58→// receive the env var via cmd.Env instead.
    59→func NewTestEnv(t *testing.T) *TestEnv {
    60→	t.Helper()
    61→
    62→	// Resolve symlinks on macOS where /var -> /private/var
    63→	// This ensures the CLI subprocess and test use consistent paths
    64→	repoDir := t.TempDir()
    65→	if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(repoDir); err == nil {
    66→		repoDir = resolved
    67→	}
    68→	claudeProjectDir := t.TempDir()
    69→	if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(claudeProjectDir); err == nil {
    70→		claudeProjectDir = resolved
    71→	}
    72→	geminiProjectDir := t.TempDir()
    73→	if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(geminiProjectDir); err == nil {
    74→		geminiProjectDir = resolved
    75→	}
    76→
    77→	env := &TestEnv{
    78→		T:                t,
    79→		RepoDir:          repoDir,
    80→		ClaudeProjectDir: claudeProjectDir,
    81→		GeminiProjectDir: geminiProjectDir,
    82→	}
    83→
    84→	// Note: Don't use t.Setenv here - it's incompatible with t.Parallel()
    85→	// CLI commands receive ENTIRE_TEST_CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR or ENTIRE_TEST_GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR via cmd.Env instead
    86→
    87→	return env
    88→}

    97→// This method is kept to avoid breaking existing tests that call defer env.Cleanup().

   197→// RunForAllStrategies runs a test function for each strategy in parallel.
   198→// This reduces boilerplate for tests that need to verify behavior across all strategies.
   199→// Each subtest gets its own TestEnv with a feature branch ready for testing.
   200→func RunForAllStrategies(t *testing.T, testFn func(t *testing.T, env *TestEnv, strategyName string)) {
   201→	t.Helper()
   202→	for _, strat := range AllStrategies() {
   203→		strat := strat // capture for parallel
   204→		t.Run(strat, func(t *testing.T) {
   205→			t.Parallel()
   206→			env := NewFeatureBranchEnv(t, strat)
   207→			testFn(t, env, strat)
   208→		})
   209→	}
   210→}

   306→// initEntireInternal is the common implementation for InitEntire variants.
   307→func (env *TestEnv) initEntireInternal(strategyName string, agentName agent.AgentName, strategyOptions map[string]any) {
   308→	env.T.Helper()
   309→
   310→	// Create .entire directory structure
   311→	entireDir := filepath.Join(env.RepoDir, ".entire")
   312→	if err := os.MkdirAll(entireDir, 0o755); err != nil {
   313→		env.T.Fatalf("failed to create .entire directory: %v", err)
   314→	}
   315→
   316→	// Create tmp directory
   317→	tmpDir := filepath.Join(entireDir, "tmp")
   318→	if err := os.MkdirAll(tmpDir, 0o755); err != nil {
   319→		env.T.Fatalf("failed to create .entire/tmp directory: %v", err)
   320→	}
   321→
   322→	// Write settings.json
   323→	settings := map[string]any{
   324→		"strategy":  strategyName,
   325→		"local_dev": true, // Note: git-triggered hooks won't work (path is relative); tests call hooks via getTestBinary() instead
   326→	}
   327→	// Only add agent if specified (otherwise defaults to claude-code)
   328→	if agentName != "" {
   329→		settings["agent"] = string(agentName)
   330→	}
   331→	if strategyOptions != nil {
   332→		settings["strategy_options"] = strategyOptions
   333→	}
   334→	data, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(settings, "", "  ")
   335→	if err != nil {
   336→		env.T.Fatalf("failed to marshal settings: %v", err)
   337→	}
   338→	settingsPath := filepath.Join(entireDir, paths.SettingsFileName)
   339→	if err := os.WriteFile(settingsPath, data, 0o644); err != nil {
   340→		env.T.Fatalf("failed to write %s: %v", paths.SettingsFileName, err)
   341→	}
   342→}

   645→	ID               string

   647→	MetadataDir      string

   655→// GetRewindPoints returns available rewind points using the CLI.
   656→func (env *TestEnv) GetRewindPoints() []RewindPoint {
   657→	env.T.Helper()
   658→
   659→	// Run rewind --list using the shared binary
   660→	cmd := exec.Command(getTestBinary(), "rewind", "--list")
   661→	cmd.Dir = env.RepoDir
   662→	cmd.Env = env.cliEnv()
   663→
   664→	output, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
   665→	if err != nil {
   666→		env.T.Fatalf("rewind --list failed: %v\nOutput: %s", err, output)
   667→	}
   668→
   669→	// Parse JSON output
   670→	var jsonPoints []struct {
   671→		ID               string `json:"id"`
   672→		Message          string `json:"message"`
   673→		MetadataDir      string `json:"metadata_dir"`
   674→		Date             string `json:"date"`
   675→		IsTaskCheckpoint bool   `json:"is_task_checkpoint"`
   676→		ToolUseID        string `json:"tool_use_id"`
   677→		IsLogsOnly       bool   `json:"is_logs_only"`
   678→		CondensationID   string `json:"condensation_id"`
   679→	}
   680→
   681→	if err := json.Unmarshal(output, &jsonPoints); err != nil {
   682→		env.T.Fatalf("failed to parse rewind points: %v\nOutput: %s", err, output)
   683→	}
   684→
   685→	points := make([]RewindPoint, len(jsonPoints))
   686→	for i, jp := range jsonPoints {
   687→		date, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, jp.Date)
   688→		points[i] = RewindPoint{
   689→			ID:               jp.ID,
   690→			Message:          jp.Message,
   691→			MetadataDir:      jp.MetadataDir,
   692→			Date:             date,
   693→			IsTaskCheckpoint: jp.IsTaskCheckpoint,
   694→			ToolUseID:        jp.ToolUseID,
   695→			IsLogsOnly:       jp.IsLogsOnly,
   696→			CondensationID:   jp.CondensationID,
   697→		}
   698→	}
   699→
   700→	return points
   701→}

   802→// FileExistsInBranch checks if a file exists in a specific branch's tree.
   803→func (env *TestEnv) FileExistsInBranch(branchName, filePath string) bool {
   804→	env.T.Helper()
   805→
   806→	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(env.RepoDir)
   807→	if err != nil {
   808→		env.T.Fatalf("failed to open git repo: %v", err)
   809→	}
   810→
   811→	// Get the branch reference
   812→	ref, err := repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(branchName), true)
   813→	if err != nil {
   814→		// Try as a remote-style ref
   815→		ref, err = repo.Reference(plumbing.ReferenceName("refs/heads/"+branchName), true)
   816→		if err != nil {
   817→			return false
   818→		}
   819→	}
   820→
   821→	// Get the commit
   822→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   823→	if err != nil {
   824→		return false
   825→	}
   826→
   827→	// Get the tree
   828→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   829→	if err != nil {
   830→		return false
   831→	}
   832→
   833→	// Check if file exists
   834→	_, err = tree.File(filePath)
   835→	return err == nil
   836→}

   848→	// Get the branch reference
   849→	ref, err := repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(branchName), true)
   850→	if err != nil {
   851→		// Try as a remote-style ref
   852→		ref, err = repo.Reference(plumbing.ReferenceName("refs/heads/"+branchName), true)
   853→		if err != nil {
   854→			return "", false
   855→		}
   856→	}
   857→
   858→	// Get the commit
   859→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   860→	if err != nil {
   861→		return "", false
   862→	}
   863→
   864→	// Get the tree

   870→	// Get the file

   878→	if err != nil {

   882→	return content, true
